confidence_interval.sampling_unit: heldout graph, retaining all seed replicates

cpu_gate.note: Planner calls and oracle-call counts are matched; observed CPU may diverge as version spaces shrink. If 20% tolerance fails, do not claim measured CPU parity.

limitations: All 64 graph hypotheses and copy-equation family are supplied, so inference is finite hypothesis elimination, not discovery of a new graph family
Each graph receives repeated seeds; confidence intervals resample graphs, not individual rows
Exogenous inputs are binary 0/1 within the canonical 4-bit ISA, and the policy can intervene on any register
Passive observations are designed to be identical for all graphs; active superiority is narrow and by construction
Candidate graphs may include heldout graph structures in the model's hypothesis set; heldout means true environment was not used for fitting or decisions
Matched planning-work/oracle calls do not automatically mean measured CPU parity; measured ratios and an explicit gate are reported
No graph-identification guarantee beyond this finite family; no AGI, new mathematical discovery or champion promotion
CPU excludes candidate family enumeration and per-case ISA compilation; those are common setup costs
Controls intentionally compute the active planner score but ignore it to equalize planning work
Source has not been independently verified at manifest submission; a different reviewer must reproduce and judge
Graph-bootstrap 95% interval active minus random includes zero: no statistically robust active superiority
negative_controls: All 64 models have identical passive observations; specific do() separates distinct graph structures
Uniform random distinct-node interventions, matched to active in oracle count and candidate-simulation workload
Passive observation with same ISA oracle-call count and same counterfactual planning workload
Independent scalar SCM simulator versus ISA oracle on all 512 graph/action/bit configurations
Implausible oracle response excludes every candidate and fails closed
Altered true graph label and altered intervention response each fail deterministic replay
outcome: NO_CONFIRMED_GAIN_OVER_RANDOM (active point estimate greater; 95% graph-clustered CI includes zero)
